supporting_pages.title: "Create an ecommerce streaming pipeline \_|\_ Cloud Dataflow \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Run the following command once for each of the following IAM roles: roles/dataflow.admin roles/dataflow.worker roles/pubsub.editor roles/bigquery.dataEditor roles/bigtable.admin roles/bigquery.jobUser gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding PROJECT ID \ --member = serviceAccount:retailpipeline@ PROJECT ID .iam.gserviceaccount.com \ --role = ROLE Optional: Revoke the authentication credentials that you created, and delete the local credential file. gcloud auth application-default revoke Optional: Revoke credentials from the gcloud CLI. gcloud auth revoke What's next View the sample application on GitHub .

Use the cbt createtable command to create a table: cbt -instance = aggregate-tables createtable PageView5MinAggregates Use the following command to add a column family to the table: cbt -instance = aggregate-tables createfamily PageView5MinAggregates pageViewAgg Run the pipeline Use Gradle to run a streaming pipeline.
